FX-SCATZ-001.says: As added: on a picture 32 pixels high each dot is thrown up to a pixel and a half, a fine dusting.

FX-SCATZ-002.says: Amount 300: a cloud of dots thrown up to about 9 pixels.

FX-SCATZ-003.says: Amount -300: every dot thrown the opposite way to FX-SCATZ-002.

FX-SCATZ-004.says: Amount 0: every dot on its own pixel, the picture untouched.

FX-SCATZ-005.says: Right Twist 90, Amount 0: the right edge turned edge-on, the picture squeezed towards the middle row more and more to the right.

FX-SCATZ-006.says: Left Twist 180, Amount 0: the left edge turned upside down, the picture squeezed through the middle row a third of the way across.

FX-SCATZ-007.says: Right Twist 60, Left Twist -60, Amount 100: the two ends turned opposite ways, dusted.

FX-SCATZ-008.says: Screen: the cloud of FX-SCATZ-002, the dots screened.

FX-SCATZ-009.says: Add: the dots' colours added, so where they bunch they brighten.

FX-SCATZ-010.says: Alpha Add: colours and opacities added.

FX-SCATZ-011.says: The picture with its right half clear: only the left half's dots, some thrown across into the clear half.

FX-SCATZ-012.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 300 at frame 12: at frame 0 the picture untouched, then the cloud gathering out.

FX-SCATZ-013.says: FX-SCATZ-002 moved 3 pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SCATZ-014.says: Both twists 360, Amount 0: a whole turn at every column, the picture untouched.

FX-SCATZ-015.says: Right Twist 720, Amount 50: the ribbon turned twice over across the picture.

FX-SCATZ-016.says: Amount 3000: most dots thrown past the edge, a thin scatter left.

FX-SCATZ-017.says: Right Twist 90 with Add, Amount 0: the dots piled where the right edge is edge-on add up bright.

FX-SCATZ-018.says: Amount 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATZ-019.says: Amount -10001, below -10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATZ-020.says: Right Twist 36001, above 36000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATZ-021.says: Left Twist -36001, below -36000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATZ-022.says: Transfer Mode written "multiply". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATZ-023.says: Amount keyed to 20000 at frame 4, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
